g1.label: 1. Companies were ___ in California
g1.why: To found a company means to start it.

g2.label: 2. An ___ starts a business
g2.why: An entrepreneur is a person who starts a business and takes the risk.

g3.label: 3. Startups need ___
g3.why: Venture capital is money that investors put into new, risky companies.

g4.label: 4. A small ___
g4.why: A prototype is an early test version of a product.

g5.label: 5. Plans to ___ its new product
g5.why: To launch a product means to make it available to the public.

g6.label: 6. A company's main office
g6.why: A company's headquarters is its main office.

g7.label: 7. A long ___
g7.why: A commute is the daily journey between home and work.

g8.label: 8. Government ___
g8.why: A regulation is an official rule; privacy laws are one kind.

g1.label: 1. The founder said the app ___
g1.why: Reported speech: 'will launch' moves back to 'would launch' after 'said'.

g2.label: 2. The engineers explained that they ___
g2.why: Reported speech: present progressive 'are testing' becomes 'were testing'.

g3.label: 3. Analysts predict that companies ___
g3.why: 'Predict' is in the present, so the future 'will invest' stays unchanged.

g4.label: 4. A student said she ___
g4.why: Reported speech: 'I am applying' becomes 'she was applying'.

g5.label: 5. The article reported that rents ___
g5.why: Reported speech: present perfect 'have risen' moves back to 'had risen'.

g6.label: 6. If the trial ___, investors will fund
g6.why: Conditional type 1: if + present simple, then will + infinitive.

g7.label: 7. The team ___ the product next week
g7.why: 'Going to' describes a plan for the future, here 'next week'.

g8.label: 8. The CEO said remote work ___
g8.why: Reported speech: 'has changed' moves back to 'had changed' after 'said'.
